full_judgment:
"A Rule Nisi be issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why the impugned Gazette Notification under the signature of respondent No. 5 so far it relates to the acquisition of land of the petitioners measuring 2.00 acres situated in RS Plot No. 25 in RS Khatian Nos. 15 of Mouza Uttar Ramchandrapur under Saver Police Station (now police Station Ashulia), District-Dhaka in connection with LA Case No. 1 of 1999-2000 shall not be declared to have been issued without lawful authority and is of no legal effect and why the Respondents shall not be directed to release the acquired 2.00 acres of land situated in RS Plot No. 25 in RS Khatian No. 15 of Mouza Uttar Ramchandrapur under Savar Police Station, District-Dhaka in connection with LA Case No. 1 of 1999-2000 in favor of the petitioners effect and/or pass such other or further order or orders as to this Courts may seem fit and proper." 

 4. Short facts as disclosed in the writ petition No. 3488 of 2000 in short is that petitioner No. 1 after his retirement from government service purchased 2.00 acres of land in RS Plot No. 25 having RS Khatian No. 15 in Mouja Uttor Ramchandpur under Police Station vide registered sale deed No. 15071 dated 8-7-1997 with a view to construct residence for himself and for his five sons and daughters having no housing accommodation at Dhaka. After purchase he demarcated boundary, erected barbed were fencing, mutated his name in the record of right and paid government revenues. Similarly petitioner No. 2-5 also with a view to construct residence purchased 0.45 acres of land by separate deeds in their names in 1998. While they have been owning and possessing as mentioned above they came to know that LA case No. 1 of 1999-2000 has been commenced for acquiring an area of 6.55 acres of land covering the case plot for Udyog Multipurpose Co-operative Society Limited with a view to materialize a housing scheme. The said housing society earlier got acquired 1.50 acres of land for establishing housing scheme. On the proposal of the said housing society Deputy Commissioner Dhaka acquired 1.23 acres of land vide LA Case No. 06 of 1976-1977 purportedly with a view to provide civic facility but no step was taken towards that end. After commencement of acquisition proceeding No.1 of 1999-2000 Ministry of land through its senior Assistant Secretary at the instance of Ministry of land an inquiry was conducted by LA officials and others vide annexure E-1 which was sent by Additional Deputy Commissioner Dhaka to the ministry of land wherein recommendation has been made not to acquire the land as it is not necessary for development project because the project could be implemented in the earlier acquired land, inspite of that the acquisition proceeding has been commenced and notice under section 3 of the acquisition and requisition immovable property ordinance was served beyond the knowledge of the petitioners without issuing public notice but after prolonged search the petitioner collected a copy of the notice issued under section 3 of the ordinance. The proposed acquisition proceeding is not for any public purpose which is Cristal clear from the report submitted by the land acquisition officer and others. Subsequently a notice under section 6 of the acquisition and requisition of immovable property ordinance, 1982 was served beyond the petitioner's knowledge and on coming to know about the said notice the petitioner filed objection against the said process and, as such, the petitioners were constrained to filed the instant writ petition. 

 7. In writ petition No. 6348 of 2011, the heirs of writ petitioner No. 1 of writ petition No. 3488 of 2000 being petitioner Nos. 1-4 and along with 2 others as petitioners asserted the same facts as advanced in earlier writ petition and challenged the gazette notification dated 10-8-2006 issued under signature No. 5 so far it relates to acquisition of 2.00 acres of land in plot No. 25 having Khatian No. 15 under Mouza Uttar Ramchandrapur, within Savar Police Station present Ashulia Police Station, District-Dhaka. 

 24. The impugned acquisition proceeding contained in the notice under section 3 of Acquisition and Requisition of Immovable Properties Ordinance, 1982 (Annexure-F) in Land Acquisition Case No. 1 of 1999-2000 in respect of acquisition of lands measuring 6.56 acres contained in RS Plot Nos. 23-27, 29 and 41 in RS khatian Nos. 35, 13, 15, 37, 39 and 38 of Mouza Uttar Ramchandrapur within PS Saver, District-Dhaka in favour of one Udyog Multipurpose Co-operative Society's proposed Niribili Housing Scheme is declared to have been initiated and carried without lawful authority and is of no legal effect. 

 25. Equally the impugned gazette notification dated 10-8-2006 (Annexure-A) issued under signature No. 5 so far it relates to acquisition of land of the petitioners measuring 2.00 acres situated in RS Plot No. 25 in RS Khatian No. 15 of Mouza Uttar Ramchandrapur under Savar Police Station (now Police Station Ashulia), District-Dhaka in connection With LA Case No. 1 of 1999-2001 is declared to have been passed without lawful authority and is of no legal effect and respondents are directed to release the said 2.00 acres of land acquired in connection with LA case No.1 of 1999-2000 in favour of the petitioners.
